applicability: The one summary line above the intent-review reading column in both Changed and All views.
conditions: The line reports changed invariant identities and their recorded effects, changed locations in distinct files, files without an invariant, folded unchanged or not-comparable locations, and the active sort.
Changed invariant identities and recorded effects come from the outline; location and folded totals come from the shown subjects in the one change-set model.
Location and folded counts count entries, including each entry sharing a drawn region; drawing one shared card does not reduce those totals.
Files without an invariant combine unexplained and unknown-attribution buckets, taken from counted summary attribution or the ready lane inventory.
A loading part reads ellipsis; an unmeasurable part names the unavailable quantity instead of displaying a numeric count.
exclusions: The former family-count/U/K sidebar summary format.
Counting drawn cards instead of recorded location entries.
Treating a failed, incomplete or pending measurement as a measured zero.
statement: The reading column's summary counts changed invariant identities and recorded locations from the comparison model, and names loading or unavailable totals without inventing zero.
